title: Record actions
description: An edit button and a menu holding delete, for the one record another widget has open.

getRows.label: Records
getRows.hint: The list the open record belongs to; edits and deletes are written here.

getPicked.label: Open record
getPicked.hint: Bind it to the selection of the widget that opens records.

getRecord.label: Record
getRecord.hint: The record the open one names.

getFields.label: Fields
getFields.hint: What the edit form asks for: name, label, kind (line, text, number, choice, lines), options, isRequired. Empty hides edit.

getNoun.label: Called
getNoun.hint: What one record is called: Edit word, Delete word.

getTitleField.label: Title field
getTitleField.hint: The field the delete question names the record by.
